Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to place up to 3 cards from under multiples of my Tamers in the digivolution cards of the Digimon card to be played?

Card Q&A.a: You process this card's [Your Turn] effect first. After processing the "when you would play" effect, you can then perform the DigiXros. Once you use this card's [Your Turn] effect to place cards under the card to be played, then you place the cards for the DigiXros under the cards you just placed for the effect.
Card Q&A.q: When I would play a [Bagra Army] trait card with DigiXros requirements, do I process this card's [Your Turn] effect or the DigiXros of the card to be played first?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't activate it. This card's [Your Turn] effect triggers when you would play 1 level 4 or higher [Bagra Army] trait Digimon card. It doesn't trigger when you would play 2 or more at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when I would play 2 or more level 4 or higher [Bagra Army] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time?

Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When a purple card is placed under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck), and gain 1 memory.

[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you would play a level 4 or higher Digimon card with [Bagra Army] in its traits, by placing up to 3 purple Digimon cards from under your Tamers in the played Digimon card's digivolution cards, reduce the play cost of that Digimon by 2 for each card placed.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
